p: Macaulay Street is within easy reach of Huddersfield town centre, so Storeys is a handy stop if you're in town. The town's railway station is one of the grandest in the country to look at, with its huge columned front on St George's Square and a statue of Harold Wilson, who was born in Huddersfield, outside.

For a view, head up to Castle Hill and the Victoria Tower, which overlook the whole town and the Pennines. The Huddersfield Narrow Canal heads west towards Standedge Tunnel at Marsden, the longest canal tunnel in Britain.
Storeys is strictly 18+, so bring ID if you're likely to be asked.
